llm.summary: Review before installing: the secret-copying and production deployment examples lack safeguards against credential exposure and outages.

dimensions.detail: CONTEXT-SWITCHING.md's production deployment loop labels a pod query 'Wait for healthy' without defining readiness criteria or stopping on unhealthy results. SKILL.md's production-named scaling example also omits an explicit context despite its own production context rule.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains two Markdown files and requests named kubectl-mcp-server toolsets. No installation script or concealed executable payload is bundled; the external server implementation is outside this artifact review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Both secret-sync examples query namespace-wide secrets and apply an unspecified manifest to another cluster without selecting individual secrets or checking destination authorization and trust. Generic activation keywords add ambiguity but do not mandate automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Saving workload-cluster kubeconfigs and changing the current context are disclosed administration behaviors. Separate credentials and read-only production access are recommended. No background persistence, hidden privilege escalation, or unrelated credential collection is shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Kubeconfig access, cluster lifecycle management, Helm deployment, and GitOps operations fit the disclosed Kubernetes administration purpose. The scanner's credential-theft and GitOps mismatch interpretations are unsupported.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Start with read-only production access. Approve specific clusters and individual secrets before copying credentials, following [Kubernetes secret-access guidance](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/secrets-good-practices/). Require a successful health check that stops deployment on failure before proceeding to another region, and explicitly select the management context before scaling.
